get.summary: Gets the progress and analytics dashboard for the current user.

post.description:
Creates a new user in the database and returns a JWT Token.
**Required Fields:** `FirstName`, `LastName`, `Email`, `Password`.
Passwords must match and follow security standards (e.g., minimum length).

200.description: Registration successful — returns AuthResponse containing the JWT token

400.description: Email already exists or validation failed

post.description:
Authenticates the user and returns a JWT Token on Success.
The JWT Token must be included in the `Authorization: Bearer {token}` header for all secured endpoints.

requestBody.description: The user's login credentials (Email and Password)

200.description: Login successful — returns AuthResponse containing the JWT token

post.summary: Request a 6-digit OTP for password reset
post.description: Generates a secure 6-digit one-time password and sends it to the user's email. Always returns the same successful response to prevent account enumeration. The OTP expires after 15 minutes.

post.summary: Reset a password using the 6-digit OTP
post.description: Validates the OTP sent to the user's email, then updates the password. Returns 400 if the OTP is incorrect or has expired.
Requires the user to be authenticated and to provide their current password.

post.summary: Send a message and receive an AI response
post.description:
Sends a user message to the AI.
Set **searchWeb: False** to query your uploaded documents contextually.
**Note:** Do not send `UserId` or `AllowedDocumentIds` in the request body; they are resolved automatically on the backend from the Token and Session.

200.description: Returns AIMessageResponse containing the AI's answer, confidence score, and document citations

400.description: Message processing failed, Validation Error, or SearchWeb is true

post.summary: Send a message and receive a Web Search response
post.description:
Sends a user message to the AI but forces it to search the live web for answers instead of local documents.
Set **searchWeb: True**.
**Note:** Do not send `UserId` or `AllowedDocumentIds` in the request body.

200.description: Returns WebSearchResponse containing the AI's answer and the web sources

400.description: Message processing failed, Validation Error, or SearchWeb is false

get.summary: Get all messages in a chat session

post.summary: Convert an audio file to text (Transcription)
post.description:
Transcribes a spoken audio file into text using the AI Speech-To-Text model.
Useful for capturing user voice queries before sending them to the AI.
Accepts standard audio formats (wav, mp3, m4a, etc.). Max size: 10MB.

400.description: Audio processing failed, invalid format, or missing file

post.summary: Generate playable audio for an existing AI message
post.description:
Generates a Text-To-Speech (TTS) audio file for a specific message that the AI previously generated.
If the audio was already generated before, it returns the cached URL instantly.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The GUID of the AI's chat message

200.description: Returns TTSResponse with the URL of the generated/cached audio file

400.description: TTS generation failed, message not found, or unauthorized access

post.description:
Initializes a new chat session. Pass a list of `DocumentIds` to scope the AI context.
The JWT Token must be passed in the `Authorization` header.

400.description: Validation error or Document ID does not belong to user

get.summary: Get all chat sessions for the current user(Chat History)

put.summary: Update the title of a chat session
put.description: Allows the user or frontend to dynamically rename a chat session.

400.description: Validation error or Session Not Found

delete.summary: Delete a chat session by ID

post.description:
Accepts a file upload via `multipart/form-data`. 
**Required Fields:** `File` (the physical file), `SubjectId` (groups the document).
After upload, the file is queued for background processing (text extraction and chunking).

200.description: Document uploaded and queued for processing — returns DocumentResponse

400.description: Validation error (e.g., file too large or invalid format)

put.description: Allows changing a document's Title, associating it with a new Subject.

200.description: Document updated successfully — returns updated DocumentResponse

400.description: Validation error or Document not found

get.summary: Get all documents for the current user
get.description: Retrieves every document uploaded by the authenticated user, regardless of subject.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a document.
**Warning:** This deletes the database record, the physical file in storage, and triggers a purge of all associated AI Knowledge Graph entities.

400.description: Document not found or belongs to another user

get.summary: Get all documents under a specific subject

post.summary: Retry processing a document that previously failed
post.description:
Only documents with a **FAILED** processing status can be retried.
Attempting to retry a PENDING, PROCESSING, or COMPLETED document will return 400.
On success the document status is reset to PENDING and the chunking job is re-queued.

400.description: Document is not in FAILED status, or validation error

get.summary: Securely view or download a document

404.description: Document or physical file not found

get.summary: Get chunks for a specific document
get.description:
Retrieves the processed chunks (text segments) of an uploaded document.
This is useful for frontend debugging or displaying how the document was split for RAG.

200.description: Returns a list of document chunks

404.description: No chunks found or document is still processing

post.summary:
Mock MCQ generation — generates one question per quiz chunk.
Accepts the same McqGenerateRequest the real Python service expects.

Mock quiz chunking - creates quiz-ready chunks from the document metadata.
Accepts the same AIChunkRequest the real Python service expects.
Initiate quiz generation or reuse a cached quiz
post.description:
Computes a hash from userId + sorted documentIds.
- Returns **200** if an identical READY quiz already exists (cache hit).
- Returns **202** if a new generation job was enqueued.
- Returns **409** if generation is already in progress for this combination.
- Returns **400** on validation errors (invalid documents, subject, etc.).

get.description:
Creates a new attempt row. Options are shuffled server-side using Fisher-Yates
seeded by the attemptId. The shuffle mapping is stored server-side only —
the response contains **no correct-answer information**.

post.summary: Submit answers and receive a score
post.description:
**Idempotent** — submitting the same attemptId twice returns the original score.
The server reverse-maps shuffled option labels to original labels before scoring.

get.summary: List all attempts for a quiz by the current user
Full review of a completed attempt
get.description:
Returns correct answers, the student's answers, AI explanations, and
source chunk citations for each question.

get.summary: Paginated, filterable history of all quizzes generated by the user
All quizzes for a specific subject

post.description:
Subjects act as folders to group related documents together.
Subject names must be unique per user.

requestBody.description: Contains the `Name` of the new subject.

400.description: Validation Error or Subject Name already exists

get.summary: Get all subjects for the current user
get.description: Retrieves a list of all subjects created by the authenticated user, along with a nested list of their associated Documents.

200.description: List of subjects and their documents

put.description: Updates the name of an existing subject.

requestBody.description: Contains the new `Name` for the subject.

400.description: Validation Error or Name already exists

delete.description:
Deletes the subject. 
**Warning:** This will also permanently delete all Documents grouped under this subject, including their physical files and AI Knowledge Graph data.

200.description: Subject and its associated documents deleted

400.description: Subject not found or validation error

get.summary: Get documents for a subject (Dropdown Optimized)
get.description:
Returns a lightweight list containing only the `Id` and `FileName` of the documents belonging to a subject.
Optimized for use in dropdown menus when creating a new Chat Session.
Fetches the profile data (FirstName, LastName, Email) for the currently authenticated user.

delete.summary: Delete the current user's account permanently

chunk_id.description: Primary source chunk that generated this question.

correctOption.description: The original (unshuffled) correct label stored in DB.

selectedOption.description: The original label the student selected (after reverse-mapping).

otp.description: The 6-digit one-time password sent to the user's email.
